# GTPSCloud Lua Learning Pack

> Community API reference, user-confirmed runtime patterns, and Lua examples for AI coding assistants working with GTPSCloud.

## Start Here

- [Agent Instructions](AGENTS.md): Read before writing code. New project guidance and comments should be in English.
- [Runtime Notes](GTPSCloud-Runtime-Notes.md): User-confirmed Discord and timer conventions, sandbox constraints, and unresolved assumptions.
- [In-Game Patterns](GTPSCloud-Ingame-Patterns.md): Command input, dialog payload tables, role metadata, sessions, and item operations.
- [README](README.md): Setup, reading order, and example commands.

## API Reference

- [Full API Snapshot](GTPSCloud-API.md): 33 sections from the official documentation.
- [API Examples](GTPSCloud-API-Examples.md): Recipes and 784 minimal-call entries, including alternate utility forms.
- [Official Documentation](https://dash.gtps.cloud/docs): Upstream documentation.

## Essential Constraints

- Do not assume pcall or os.date exists.
- tryCall falls back to a direct call when pcall is absent; exceptions still propagate.
- This project's working scripts use os.time(), timer.setTimeout(...), timer.clear(...), and static DiscordBot.method(...) calls.
- Event and player instance methods use colon syntax.
- In-game dialog callbacks receive (world, player, data), where data contains dialog_name and buttonClicked.
- Working command/dialog handlers return true for handled and false for unrelated events. Do not generalize this into cancellation behavior for all callbacks.
- HTTP, database, file, bitwise, and interval bindings are not confirmed by the supplied working scripts.
- Never claim live-server verification based only on syntax checks or mocks.
